integrity: The proof is mathematical rather than experimental; rational checks provide finite corroboration. Priority is a best-knowledge literature assessment; no independent examination or certification is claimed.
limitations: Unit-rate, one-way, finite directed cycles; fixed equal positive time step and fixed number of powers, exact arithmetic. Other directed graphs, variable rates and mixed step sizes are not addressed.
title: Two-step positivity and a three-state parity exception for cyclic Crank–Nicolson
